newsitem.title: USA: United Illuminating warns on stranded costs.
newsitem.headline: United Illuminating warns on stranded costs.

text.p: Connecticut's debate over deregulating its electricity industry hinges on how suppliers can recover their stranded costs, United Illuminating Co. chief executive Richard Grossi said on Tuesday.
"If there's one major issue, that's the major issue," Grossi told Reuters in an interview.
Stranded costs are typically linked to power plants built prior to market deregulation, when their costs could be passed on through the rates utilities charged their customers.
Deregulation is among the most contentious issues in the current legislative session, which ends in June.
